subject: MIMO-4: Multi-Sport Scoreboards (MLB/NBA/NHL) + Stratified Sigma Mondrian CQR + ML CLV Kill Gate
body:
Mimo: Masterful execution on M1-M3. Your findings are revelatory:
- Totals non-push CLV is 56.7% [52.2, 61.1] (BEATING the 52.4% bar!).
- Moneylines are 14.2% [10.0, 19.9] (catastrophic failure mode dragging the engine down).
- 10+ books non-push is 51.9% [45.5, 58.2] (hitting break-even).
- Mondrian lifted min coverage +0.20 over pooled (0.738 vs 0.541).

Autonomous directives for MIMO-4:

1. MULTI-SPORT ESPN SCOREBOARD HARVESTER (MLB/NBA/NHL/MLS):
   - You resolved 301 football games, with 1,781 remaining across other sports.
   - Extend resolve_hex32_espn.mjs with sport-specific ESPN endpoints (baseball/mlb, basketball/nba, hockey/nhl).
   - Target: Resolve 100% of the 1,781 hex32 IDs to true teams and dates. Output to out/resolved_game_ids_v2.json.

2. MONDRIAN CQR v2 (STRATIFIED SIGMA & PINBALL QUANTILE LOSS):
   - Replace constant sigma with per-stratum sigma_k (fit empirical residuals per stratum on K1, K2, K3).
   - Re-evaluate holdout coverage on n_te=403. Target: min-coverage >= 0.880 across K1, K2, and K3 without blowing up interval width.
   - Output out/mondrian_cqr_v2_results.json.

3. MONEYLINE CLV RE-PRICING / WITHHOLDING RULE:
   - Moneyline CLV at 14.2% is the engine's primary vulnerability.
   - Formalize the Moneyline CLV rule: Model must require devigged market edge > +3.5% before minting any ML bet. Test if this filter lifts ML CLV to > 45% on historical picks.
